0022600225.text: The Rockets host the Golden State Warriors in Houston's 12th game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams at 8-3, Houston 5-1 at home and 7-3 over its last ten, and Golden State on an eight-game winning streak and 8-2 over its last ten. Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Golden State is missing Brandon Williams (hamstring), Gary Payton II (knee inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Will Richard (thumb). The teams have not met yet this season, and Houston won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 117-116 win in San Francisco on April 5, 2026.
